paragraphs.text: The Mask of Night's Reach was a powerful artifact from Kamigawa that allowed its user to steal black -aligned powers.

A copy was given to Leshrac by Night herself, who used it to gain Phage 's and Nicol Bolas ' touch. The real one was taken by Bolas, who employed it to imprison Leshrac within it and close the Madaran rift .
